title: Structure-Aware Tensorial Model Reduction
summary: This work investigates a two-stage method for constructing projection-based reduced-order models (ROMs) of parameterized partial differential equations (PDEs). Based on established tensorial ROM methodology, the proposed approach reduces dimensionality offline by encoding solution snapshots using a multi-linear Tucker factorization, so that a reduced basis which varies nonlinearly with PDE parameters can be rapidly constructed online and used in a Galerkin ROM.
